pin_regs.reason: Source-registered: ot_hdc_v41x_idx_hslice_fp flops every input at the pin (pin flop) and every output leaves a flop (q / key 2 edges pin to pin); the chunk schedule (cs_out = key_in + LAT_T + FPL + 2 + FPL*hid) is priced on those edges, a recipe pin stage would shift it.

why_floorplan: DIE-S81-85 svc provider form A IRG box (plan v3 c5dd067e64aef615 svc_lo u_irg.g_ch[c].u_c.g_s[h].u_s): 60.48 x 276.48 exact, the band height; the 8 slices of a chunk abut W->E at 69.12 pitch (8.64 seams), so the chain faces are W (ql / k_key / cs_in) and E (qo / ko_key / cs_out); clk / rst_n / hid / first straps from the chunk relay on N.  Fill 0.516-0.532: COORD 11-09 decision (a) IRG fastpad first form at 0.516-0.532 (COORD 08:4x highest-fill-that-routes); ONE pilot kit before the other svc_lo kits; fallback (b) = 77.76-wide re-pack at fill 0.399.
